articles.title: shipwatch added to PyPI
articles.summary: Shipwatch is a new tool designed to monitor and summarize actual releases from AI companies weekly. By processing changelogs and release notes, it generates a scored briefing, validating claims with sources. This enables users, like SSB aspirants interested in technology trends, to stay efficiently informed about the latest AI advancements and developments in the industry.

articles.title: Roy Scheider Was In A Forgettable Sequel To A Genre-Defining Sci-Fi Movie
articles.summary: The film "2010: The Year We Make Contact" features an impressive cast, with Roy Scheider starring as astronaut Heywood Floyd. He is joined by John Lithgow and Bob Balaban, portraying his fellow American space team members. The movie delves into themes of space exploration and making contact, highlighting the ensemble's roles in this intriguing science fiction narrative.
